scenario.name: Bank operations AI capability build
assumptions: Fictional 200-person bank operations unit; not a client or a staffing estimate for JPMorgan/BAC.
Demand represents distinct, non-overlapping capability assignments. Candidate pools are disjoint across skills and routes.
Upfront training cost is $5,000 instruction plus 80 learning hours at $50 per hour; redeployment $5,000; recruiting and onboarding $24,000.

Annual recurring costs are incremental pay/license uplift ($12,000 training), backfill/opportunity cost ($42,000 redeployment), and fully loaded new-hire cost ($150,000). Existing base payroll is common to the decision and excluded.
Recurring costs apply to every candidate from month 1, including unsuccessful candidates. Benefits accrue only to expected successful capability after readiness. No salvage value, tax or inflation.
Success rates represent expected attainment, not guaranteed headcount. No attrition after attainment; no claim about displacement or headcount reduction.
Annual value is modeled gross incremental operating contribution per successful capability; it is neither estimated from filings nor a BLS wage.

staffing_inputs.name: Bank operations AI capability build
assumptions: Fictional 200-person bank operations unit; not a client or a staffing estimate for JPMorgan/BAC.
Demand represents distinct, non-overlapping capability assignments. Candidate pools are disjoint across skills and routes.
Upfront training cost is $5,000 instruction plus 80 learning hours at $50 per hour; redeployment $5,000; recruiting and onboarding $24,000.

Annual recurring costs are incremental pay/license uplift ($12,000 training), backfill/opportunity cost ($42,000 redeployment), and fully loaded new-hire cost ($150,000). Existing base payroll is common to the decision and excluded.
Recurring costs apply to every candidate from month 1, including unsuccessful candidates. Benefits accrue only to expected successful capability after readiness. No salvage value, tax or inflation.
Success rates represent expected attainment, not guaranteed headcount. No attrition after attainment; no claim about displacement or headcount reduction.
Annual value is modeled gross incremental operating contribution per successful capability; it is neither estimated from filings nor a BLS wage.
